info.title: NortFox API
info.description: The API of NortFox, an open-source Swedish accounting system. Amounts travel as decimal strings, never as JSON numbers.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-nortfox-session
sessionCookie.description: The browser's session, which a sign-in sets: verifyTotp, or loginWithPassword on a known device. The browser sends it by itself.

version.description: The version of the server that answered.

type.description: A URI for the kind of problem. NortFox sends about:blank, and the code says what went wrong.

title.description: The status in words, such as Bad Request.

detail.description: What went wrong, in an English sentence.

code.description: What went wrong, as a stable kebab-case code. Clients rely on this.

errors.description: For invalid-request: what is wrong with each field.

permission.description: For permission-missing: the permission the operation needs.

pointer.description: For a rule's refusal that concerns one field: that field's JSON Pointer.

data.description: For a rule's refusal: the facts behind it.

Problem.description: Problem details (RFC 9457) with a stable code.

code.description: What is wrong with the field, as a stable kebab-case code.

detail.description: The same in an English sentence.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the field in the operation's input: the path parameters, the query parameters, the body's fields and, for a write, idempotencyKey. An empty pointer is the whole input.

data.description: The facts behind the code, such as expected, minimum, maximum or allowed. Absent when there are none.

FieldProblem.description: What is wrong with one field of a request.

organizationNumber.description: The organisation number: ten digits with a hyphen after the sixth. For a sole trader it is the owner's personal identity number.

databaseNumber.description: The company's number for programs, its tenant id. It never changes.

address.description: Adress: the postal address's street or box line. Absent when it is not set.

zipCode.description: Postnummer: the postal address's postal code. Absent when it is not set.

city.description: Ort: the postal address's town. Absent when it is not set.

countryCode.description: Land: the postal address's country, as its code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two capital letters such as SE. Absent when it is not set.

visitAddress.description: Besöksadress: the visiting address's street. Absent when it is not set.

visitZipCode.description: The visiting address's postal code. Absent when it is not set.

visitCity.description: The visiting address's town. Absent when it is not set.

visitCountryCode.description: The visiting address's country, as its code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two capital letters such as SE. Absent when it is not set.

phone.description: Telefon: the company's phone number. Absent when it is not set.

email.description: E-post: the company's e-mail address. Absent when it is not set.

Company.description: A company: its id, name, organisation number and tenant id, and its postal and visiting addresses and contact details when they are set.

SetupResult.description: The first identity of the install, with its TOTP enrolment. The person signs in next, with the password and a code.

id.description: The person's id. The person stays the actor of every entry they made.

email.description: The person's personal e-mail address. A password sign-in takes it as the identifier, in any letter case.

language.description: Språk: sv (Svenska) or en (English). It applies in every company.

User.description: A person: their NortFox ID, the one login identity they use for every company.

otpauthUri.description: The TOTP secret as an otpauth URI, for an authenticator app: show it as a QR code. The first right code of it confirms it.

TotpEnrolment.description: A new TOTP secret, which the person adds to an authenticator app.

outcome.description: signed-in: the session cookie is set, on a known device inside its 90 days. totp-required: verifyTotp comes next, with the challenge.

challenge.description: The login challenge, for verifyTotp, when the outcome is totp-required. It works for 20 minutes and for five codes.

PasswordSignIn.description: What a right password gives: a session, or the TOTP step.

Session.description: The browser's session: the person it signed in, and the company it works in once one is chosen.

personalIdentityNumber.description: The person's personnummer, in twelve digits with a hyphen. Absent until one is added.

mobile.description: The person's mobile number. Absent when none is set.

twoStep.description: How often a password sign-in asks for a TOTP code: new_device_90_days on each new device and every 90 days on a known one, or every_login.

permissions.description: The permissions the request holds in that company, in alphabetical order: a member's own, the admin level's, a program administrator's while the member administers a program, and the rights of the member's program grants. A session holds those it took when it chose the company, less a right whose grant has ended since. Empty when the request works in no company.

Me.description: The signed-in person, with their own login data, and the company the request works in with the person's membership and permissions there.

id.description: The membership's id: the member's id in the company, which the paths of /v1/users take as memberId.

userId.description: The person's id. Absent while the membership is invited.

status.description: invited, active, inactive, removed or left.

idleTimeout.description: Utloggning efter inaktivitet, in whole minutes: 15, 30, 60, 120 (2 hours, the default) or 480 (8 hours).

workEmail.description: The person's work e-mail address in this company, where its notices go. Every active and inactive member has one. An invited member has one only when updateUser gave it, and accepting the invitation sets it to the invitation's address. A removed, a left or a disconnected member has none.

workPhone.description: The person's work phone number in this company. Absent when none is set.

roles.description: The roles the member holds now, in the roles' order: owner or admin by the admin level, bookkeeper by a Bokföring grant with Full behörighet, and approver, viewer and auditor by a grant of their program that has not ended.

programs.description: The member's program grants as they are now, in the catalogue's order, also one that has ended.

programsAdministered.description: The programs the member administers, in the catalogue's order.

Membership.description: Användare in one company: a person's membership there, with its status, the system administrator's level, the idle logout, the work contacts, the roles, the program grants and the programs administered.

SysAdmin.description: Systemadministratör: owner, the person who made the company, or admin, a member made system administrator later. Both hold the same rights, and neither gives work rights by itself.

Role.description: One of the plan's six roles: owner or admin, a system administrator's level; bookkeeper, Bokföring with Full behörighet; approver, Bokföring - Attest & Läs; viewer, Läs; auditor, Revisor.

permissions.description: The rights the grant holds, as the catalogue's permission keys, in the catalogue's order.

full.description: Full behörighet: whether the grant holds every right of its program's Full behörighet, which a grant gets by default.

expiresAt.description: When the grant ends by itself, with no action by anyone: a Revisor grant 30 days after it was granted. From then on it gives nothing. Absent for a grant with no end.

ProgramGrant.description: Program: a program granted to a member, with the rights the grant holds.

Program.description: A program: bookkeeping (Bokföring), approval-read (Bokföring - Attest & Läs), read (Läs) or auditor (Revisor).

ProgramAdmin.description: Programadministratör: the member grants, narrows and removes this program, and its Rapporter and Register/Övrigt rights.

CompanyChoice.description: A company where the person is an active member, with the person's system administrator's level there when they have one.

organizationNumber.description: The organisation number: ten digits with a hyphen after the sixth. For a sole trader it is the owner's personal identity number.

databaseNumber.description: The company's number for programs, its tenant id. It never changes.

CompanySummary.description: A company as the company lists give it: its id, name, organisation number and tenant id. getCompany gives its addresses and contact details.

companies.description: The companies, the latest chosen first.

RecentCompanies.description: The three companies the person chose last, where the person is still an active member.

roles.description: The plan's six roles, in their order.

programs.description: The programs, in the catalogue's order.

groups.description: The groups, in the catalogue's order.

permissions.description: Every permission, in the catalogue's order.

PermissionCatalogue.description: The permission catalogue: the roles, the programs with their sets, the groups and the permissions, in order.

full.description: For a program's role: whether only a grant with Full behörighet makes it, as for bookkeeper.

RoleDefinition.description: One of the plan's six roles, as a set in this model: owner and admin by the admin level that adminLevel names; the other four by a grant of the program that program names, with Full behörighet when full is true.

label.description: The program's words on the screen, such as Bokföring.

lifetimeDays.description: The days after which a grant of the program ends by itself: 30 for Revisor. Absent for a program whose grant has no end.

full.description: Whether Full behörighet holds it. A permission that it does not hold is only switched on by hand.

permissions.description: The program's set: every permission a grant of it may hold, in the catalogue's order.

ProgramDefinition.description: Program: a program of the catalogue, with its screen words, its end, and its set.

PermissionKey.description: A permission of the catalogue, by its key, such as vouchers.view (Verifikationer) or vouchers.book (Bokför).

kind.description: program, for a Bokföring group of a program's own rights; reports, for Rapporter; or register, for Register/Övrigt.

label.description: The group's words on the screen, such as Verifikationer.

PermissionGroup.description: A group of permissions, with its kind and its screen words.

PermissionGroupKey.description: A group of the catalogue, by its key: vouchers (Verifikationer), supplier-invoices (Leverantörsfakturor), reports (Rapporter) or register (Register/Övrigt).

label.description: The permission's words on the screen, such as Bokför.

view.description: Whether it is its group's view right, which every other permission of the group needs.

manualOnly.description: Whether it is only switched on by hand: Full behörighet never holds it.

Permission.description: Behörighet: a permission of the catalogue, with its group, its screen words and its marks.

id.description: The membership's id: the member's id in the company, which the paths of /v1/users take as memberId.

userId.description: The person's id. Absent while the membership is invited.

name.description: The person's name; for an invited member, the name the latest invitation was sent to. Absent for an invited member with no invitation.

status.description: invited, active, inactive, removed or left.

idleTimeout.description: Utloggning efter inaktivitet, in whole minutes: 15, 30, 60, 120 (2 hours, the default) or 480 (8 hours).

workEmail.description: The person's work e-mail address in this company, where its notices go. Every active and inactive member has one. An invited member has one only when updateUser gave it, and accepting the invitation sets it to the invitation's address. A removed, a left or a disconnected member has none.

workPhone.description: The person's work phone number in this company. Absent when none is set.

roles.description: The roles the member holds now, in the roles' order: owner or admin by the admin level, bookkeeper by a Bokföring grant with Full behörighet, and approver, viewer and auditor by a grant of their program that has not ended.

programs.description: The member's program grants as they are now, in the catalogue's order, also one that has ended.

programsAdministered.description: The programs the member administers, in the catalogue's order.

Member.description: Användare: a member of the company, by the membership's id, with the person's name, the status, the system administrator's level, the idle logout, the work contacts, the roles, the program grants and the programs administered. A program administrator sees only the grants and the administration of the programs they administer, and the roles those give.

permissions.description: The member's Rapporter and Register/Övrigt rights, as the grants hold them now, in the catalogue's order.

programs.description: The member's grants as they are now, in the catalogue's order.

UserRights.description: A member's Rapporter and Register/Övrigt rights, and the program grants that hold them.

RightKey.description: A Rapporter or Register/Övrigt right of the catalogue, by its key, such as reports.vat (Momsrapport) or register.sie-export (Sie-export). A right of a program's own group, such as vouchers.view, is not one.

name.description: The name the invitation was sent to.

email.description: The e-mail address the invitation was sent to. A new identity takes it as its e-mail address.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working: 14 days after the invitation was sent.

companyName.description: The name of the company the invitation is to, as it was when the invitation was sent.

inviterName.description: The name of the system administrator who sent the invitation, as it was then.

Invitation.description: Inbjudan: an invitation to a company, as its link shows it. The link works once, for 14 days, and a newer invitation of the same member stops it.

InvitationAcceptance.description: An accepted invitation: the person who now holds the membership, and the membership. For a new identity, also its TOTP secret, which no answer gives again: the person signs in next, with the password and a code. The TOTP enrolment is absent when the signed-in identity accepted.

get.summary: Check that the server is up
get.description: Answers as soon as the server runs. It reads no data.

x-nortfox.tool: Checks that the NortFox server is up, and gives its version. It reads no data.

200.description: Whether the server is up.

400.description: The request does not fit the operation. Each field problem names its field.

500.description: The server failed. The answer holds no detail of the error.

get.description: Gives the company the request works in: its id, name, organisation number and tenant id, and its postal and visiting addresses and its phone number and e-mail address when they are set. The company comes from the request's credential.

x-nortfox.tool: Gives the company you work in: its id, name, organisation number and database number, and its postal and visiting addresses and its phone number and e-mail address when they are set. Each tool that needs a permission works in this company too, and a tool that takes a companyId works in the company it names.

200.description: A company: its id, name, organisation number and tenant id, and its postal and visiting addresses and contact details when they are set.

400.description: The request does not fit the operation. Each field problem names its field.

401.description: No actor: the request carries no credential that names one.

WWW-Authenticate.description: The challenge, as RFC 9110 asks of every 401: Cookie realm="NortFox", cookie-name="__Host-nortfox-session".

403.description: The request may not call the operation: the credential names no company (company-required), or the actor lacks the operation's permission (permission-missing).

500.description: The server failed. The answer holds no detail of the error.

patch.description: Changes the request's company: its name, its postal and visiting addresses, and its phone number and e-mail address. A field left out stays as it is, and null takes an address field or a contact detail away. The organisation number never changes, so the operation does not take it.

x-nortfox.tool: Changes the company you work in: its name, its addresses, its phone number and its e-mail address. Its organisation number never changes.

parameters.description: A key you choose for this write, 1 to 255 characters of visible ASCII without " and \. Send the same key with the same input again, and you get the first answer back instead of a second write. The draft's quoted form, "key", is taken too.

post.description: Makes the install's first identity from its setup link, with a name, an e-mail address and a password of 12 to 1024 characters. The link works once, for 28 days, on an install with no identity, and a newer link stops it. A link that the setup command made while the install's only identity never confirmed its TOTP secret replaces that identity instead. The answer gives the new TOTP secret, and no answer gives it again. It sets no session: the person signs in next, with the password and a code.

x-nortfox.tool: Makes the first identity of an empty install. It serves the browser's sign-in, so this tool refuses every call.

post.description: Signs in with an identifier, the e-mail address in any letter case or the personnummer, and the password. A right password gives the TOTP step, or a session on a known device inside its 90 days when the person's two-step choice allows it. Every failure gets the same answer. After 5 failures in an hour each attempt waits longer, and after 100 the sign-in waits until the hour has passed.

x-nortfox.tool: Signs a browser in with a password. It serves the browser's sign-in, so this tool refuses every call: an MCP client signs in through OAuth.

post.description: Accepts the invitation that a link holds, once. With newIdentity, Skapa ett nytt NortFox ID: a new identity with that name and a password of 12 to 1024 characters, which takes the invitation's e-mail address; the answer gives its TOTP secret, and sets no session, so the person signs in next with the password and a code. Without it, Koppla ihop med befintligt NortFox ID: the identity of the browser's session accepts, and with no session the call gets 422 sign-in-required. The member's work e-mail address becomes the invitation's. A link that is unknown, used, stopped by a newer invitation or past its 14 days gets one answer, 422 invitation-link-invalid. An e-mail address that another identity has gets 422 email-taken, and a person who is a member of the company already gets 422 already-member.

post.description: The signed-in person leaves the company that the path names, where the person must be an active member. The membership stays, with the status left, and its sessions end; the work contacts there are erased. Only a new invitation lets the person back. The company always keeps an active system administrator, so its last one cannot leave.
